title: ochna parvifolia
intro: Ochna parvifolia, commonly known as the small-leaved Mickey Mouse plant or small-leaved ochna, is a plant species in the family Ochnaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising treatment for various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Ochna parvifolia are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cytotoxic effects against certain cancer cell lines. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through various phytochemical studies.
